_help: Template for settings.json. Copy it to settings.json (the first run of the tool does this for you), fill in the path, save, and run Rebuild-Gs1Dictionary.cmd.
_dictionaryPath_help: Full path of gs1-syntax-dictionary.txt from a release of https://github.com/gs1/gs1-syntax-dictionary (Apache-2.0). Download the release zip, unpack it anywhere, and point to the .txt file inside. The tool only reads this file.
_descriptionsPath_help: Rotula's own long English names for the common identifiers. A relative path is relative to this script.
_outputPath_help: Where the result is written. A relative path is relative to this script.
_pauseAtEnd_help: True keeps the window open until you press Enter, so the result can be read.
